title: Cable Pebble Holder
description: A smooth weighted-feel pebble with four snap-in cable channels and small bear ears, keeps charging cables from sliding off the desk.
use: Desk cable organiser for charge / headphone / USB cables up to 4.5 mm diameter.
material: PLA/PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 20% infill; can be filled with sand or washers before sealing for extra weight (not included).
